description: Viajes GTFS_trips is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Define los viajes de cada ruta (formato GTFS). Un viaje es una secuencia de dos o más paradas que ocurre durante un período de tiempo específico. Para más información sobre el formato GTFS consultar:. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Itinerarios y horarios, Turismo. Its keywords are gtfs, viaje, viajes, paradas, rutas. The portal shows 263,042 records. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
